<style>
:root{--ink:#141517;--black:#0d0f10;--muted:#6d6c6a;--muted2:#9b9994;--paper:#f5f2ed;--light:#ece8e1;--line:#ded9d1;--red:#d83b2b;--gold:#ae9580;--white:#fff;--font:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;--narrow:'Arial Narrow','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;font-family:var(--font);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}body.lock{overflow:hidden}button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red);outline-offset:3px}img{display:block;width:100%}::selection{background:#d9412b;color:white}
.announcement{height:31px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#a72d22;color:#fff;text-align:center;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:9px;font-weight:700}.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:var(--black);color:#fff}.nav-inner{height:75px;max-width:1540px;margin:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 4.2%;gap:36px}.brand{display:inline-block;font-size:27px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:11px;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1}.main-nav{display:flex;gap:32px;align-items:center}.main-nav a{position:relative;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.7px;font-weight:700;opacity:.82;transition:opacity .2s}.main-nav a:hover,.main-nav a.active{opacity:1}.main-nav a.active:after{position:absolute;content:'';background:#fff;height:1px;left:0;right:0;bottom:-8px}.nav-actions{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center}.icon-button{border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;padding:6px;position:relative;display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center}.icon-button svg{width:21px;height:21px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.count-bubble{position:absolute;top:-3px;right:-6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:#101112;font-size:9px;width:17px;height:17px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800}.nav-toggle{display:none}
.container{width:min(1340px,91.7%);margin:0 auto}.page{min-height:70vh}.eyebrow{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:3px;font-weight:700}.eyebrow.red{color:var(--red)}.headline{font-family:var(--narrow);font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:.93;margin:0}.section-heading{font-size:clamp(38px,5.3vw,76px)}.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:20px;min-height:53px;padding:0 26px;border:1px solid var(--ink);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.7px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;transition:background .2s,color .2s,transform .2s}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)}.btn.light{background:#fff;color:#111;border-color:#fff}.btn.light:hover{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red)}.btn.outline{background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}.btn.outline:hover{background:#111;color:#fff}.btn.ghost{background:transparent;border-color:#ccc;color:#111}.btn.ghost:hover{background:#eee}.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none}.link-arrow{display:inline-flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.6px;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding-bottom:7px}
